description: How hot is the Bitcoin market today? Daily 0-100 heat score for the Bitcoin market, aggregated from 8 components (BTC-Cycle, F&G, Altcoin-Season, Bullmarket-Ampel, Funding-Rate, Hash-Ribbons, Mayer-Multiple, MVRV-Z). Returns score, band label, color, 7d/30d delta, verdict, components breakdown, plus score_percentile ranking today’s score against its own history (e.g. 42 = 44th percentile — how hot/cold vs history, not just the raw number). score_semantics says which value you hold: the daily snapshot frozen once a day by the cron, or — before that cron has run for today — a live preliminary that still moves and whose percentile/deltas compare against frozen snapshots. band_driver names the number the band follows. Pass fields="full" for `drivers[]`: each component with value, weight, contribution (they add up to the score) and percentile_rank against its own history. [Free tier]

fields.description: Omit for the default response. 'full' adds `drivers[]` — each component with value, weight, contribution (the contributions add up to the headline score), percentile_rank against its own stored history (expanding, with basis and n) — plus drivers_note with the exact arithmetic.
